answer_1.quote: Our framework implements a fully end-to-end Action Prediction strategy that directly generates navigation commands in natural language form.
answer_1.outputs: navigation commands in natural language (e.g., 'move forward', 'turn left', 'stop')

answer_2.quote: Metrics. We utilize several widely used evaluation metrics for VLN tasks: Navigation Error (NE), Oracle Success rate (OS), Success Rate (SR), Success weighted Path Length (SPL), and normalized Dynamic Temporal Wrapping (nDTW).
